summary.text: Brian Corriea, a Libertarian Party Navy veteran, husband and father from Williamston, SC, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in South Carolina's 3rd District to Sheri Biggs.
According to his campaign website, he ran a self-funded campaign that accepted no donations.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, Corriea served nine years in the U.S. Navy. He describes himself as a libertarian and as a husband and father who lives in Williamston, South Carolina.
He advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on April 11, 2026; his campaign website said the campaign was entirely self-funded and refused all donations.
He received 1.9% of the vote to Sheri Biggs's 63.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
